## cargoship mirror

Publish a built package's images and files to an OCI registry

### Synopsis

Pushes what a package carries -- its images, and the files it stages -- into a registry as individually pullable content, so the mirror a fleet is already pointed at holds what its nodes will ask for.

This is not 'cargoship publish'. That uploads the package as one artifact, to be pulled back as a package. This unpacks it: each image is pushed under the same repository path and tag it had upstream with only the registry host swapped, because that is exactly what a node asks a mirror for once cargoship has written the mirror into its containerd configuration. An image the package carries for several architectures is pushed as an index, so the registry holds every architecture the package did.

Each file is pushed as a single-layer OCI artifact named after the file and tagged with a digest of the source URL the definition declared, which keeps two releases of the same filename apart.

Give the registry as an oci:// reference, optionally with a repository prefix for a registry that will not accept a push at its root. Give --config instead and the address is read from the registry proxy the cluster configuration declares, which is the same field cargoship writes into each host, so the two cannot disagree. Credentials come from the Docker configuration file, as they do for every other cargoship registry operation.

```
cargoship mirror [Package] [REPOSITORY] [flags]
```

### Examples

```

# Mirror everything the package carries into a registry:
$ cargoship mirror ./cargoship-rke2-amd64-0.1.0.tar.zst oci://harbor.internal

# Mirror under a repository prefix, which most hosted registries require:
$ cargoship mirror ./cargoship-rke2-amd64-0.1.0.tar.zst oci://harbor.internal/cargoship

# Mirror into the proxy the cluster configuration already declares:
$ cargoship mirror ./cargoship-rke2-amd64-0.1.0.tar.zst --config ./cluster.yaml

# Mirror only the images, over plain HTTP:
$ cargoship mirror ./cargoship-rke2-amd64-0.1.0.tar.zst oci://registry.internal:5000 --images --plain-http

```

### Options

```
  -a, --architecture string                     Architecture for OCI images and Zarf packages
  -f, --config PATH                             PATH of a cluster configuration to read the destination registry from, in place of naming one as an argument. The address is taken from the single entry under spec.config.registries that declares a proxy URL, which is the mirror cargoship configures each host to pull through.
      --files[=true|false]                      Mirror only the files the package stages. Mutually exclusive with --images; both are mirrored when neither is given.
  -h, --help[=true|false]                       help for mirror
      --images[=true|false]                     Mirror only the images the package carries. Mutually exclusive with --files; both are mirrored when neither is given.
      --insecure-skip-tls-verify[=true|false]   Skip checking server's certificate for validity. This flag should only be used if you have a specific reason and accept the reduced security posture.
  -k, --key string                              Path to public key file for validating signed packages
      --oci-concurrency int                     Number of concurrent layer operations when pulling or pushing images or packages to/from OCI registries. (default 6)
      --plain-http[=true|false]                 Allow OCI registry connections over HTTP instead of HTTPS. This flag should only be used if you have a specific reason and accept the reduced security posture.
      --retries int                             Number of retries to perform for Cargoship's operations, such as package publishes.
      --tmpdir string                           Specify the temporary directory to use for intermediate files (default "/tmp")
      --verify verifyMode                       Verify the Cargoship package signature. (default if-possible)
      --zarf-cache string                       Specify the location of the Zarf cache directory (default "$HOME/.cache/cargoship")
```
